exact_statement: On disjoint uniform coordinates c,u,Z,Y with |Z|=m>=1 and |Y|>=1, let four arbitrary Boolean Y cores define G(c,u,Y), q1=1-2*1{c=c*,u=u*}, q2=1-2*1{c=c*,Z=z*}, g=q1G and q=q1q2, so F=gq=q2G. For any single positive normalized common core reference R_Y and B=average_cu C_R(h_cu), a complete normalized product final reference Q has H(F)<=C_Q(F)<=B+2I_Y(F)+4I_{c,u}(F)+(4+log2(20/7))I_Z(F). R_Y is retained unchanged, B is the actual final terminal average, and source/final core marginals coincide. If each C_R(h_cu)<=K I(h_cu), H(F)<=max(K+2,4+log2(20/7))I(F), with 4+log2(20/7)<28/5. The output-only q2=1 case is included. After any one actual core query i, carry R_Y by frequency marginalization to the SAME reference Rprime for all actual child cores and update only actual child flag priors: the complete reference decrement equals sum_T P_F(S_Y=T)log2(Rprime(T minus i)/R_Y(T)) plus h2(alpha)-average h2(alpha_child). For every K the signed ledger is K I(F)-C_Q(F)=average_child[K I(child)-C_Qchild(child)]+K Inf_i(F)-Delta C_Q. No positivity of its final signed term, universal paid core references or same-constant induction is asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform cubes, actual Boolean signs; entropy/reference costs bits and ordinary physical influences.
Source cancellation normal form g=q1G with G independent of the remaining private Z; arbitrary four unequal Y cores.
ONE common positive normalized R_Y supplied before the Fourier sample, retained across all actual source/final core terminals; separate entropy bounds cannot substitute.
Five fixed control cells cover all nonempty subsets, including unoccupied cells; weights1/4,1/4,1/16,7/20,7/80; only final empty/nonempty prior depends on alpha.
Zero/one tail endpoints use normalized supported laws and zero-mass continuity, not deletion of a positive output row.
Paid common-reference core inequalities are additional hypotheses; constants remain included in the retained-B statement.
Core query carries the same marginal reference to both actual children and preserves signed query budget; no independently available or renewed child reserve is assumed.
